blocks.text: Ek body (jism) lein jis ka mass m hai aur jo spring constant k wale spring se bandha hai; yeh smooth (chikni, friction ke baghair) horizontal surface (satah) par para hai (Fig. 14.2). Shuru mein body O par ruka hua hai; O ko mean position (darmiyani jagah) kehte hain. Ab hum body par force F laga kar use O se A tak daen taraf x displacement tak hilate hain. Hooke's law ke mutabiq lagayi gayi force displacement ke proportional (barabar nisbat mein) hoti hai:

blocks.alt: Teen qataarein; har aik mein deewar se bandhe spring par mass m, smooth farsh par. (a) Mass mean position O par rest mein. (b) Mass kheench kar A tak, O se daen taraf displacement x, aur restoring force F deewar ki taraf. (c) Mass dhakel kar O se baen taraf displacement x, spring daba hua; kitab ki tarah B ka nishan O ke daen taraf ek aur block par hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.2: Spring se bandha mass S.H.M karte hue (kitab ki Figure 14.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Text ke mutabiq B woh jagah hai jahan spring daba hua ho, yani O se baen taraf x faasle par. Dono taraf restoring force hamesha O ki taraf hoti hai.
Isi waqt spring bhi body par apni elastic restoring force lagata hai jo lagayi gayi force ke barabar magar opposite direction (ulti taraf) mein hoti hai:

Jab lagayi gayi force hata kar body ko chhora jaye to woh O ki taraf chalta hai, inertia (apni motion jaari rakhne ki aadat) ki wajah se O se aage nikal kar B tak pohanchta hai aur spring ko daba deta hai; phir wapas aata hai aur A aur B ke darmiyan jhoolne lagta hai.

blocks.title: Simple harmonic motion
blocks.text: S.H.M karne wali body ka acceleration hamesha displacement ke directly proportional hota hai aur hamesha mean position ki taraf hota hai.
